Reading the map

Follow the evidence.

Claims link to public sources. Company reports are labeled separately from catalog interpretation; confidence describes support for a claim, not independent verification. Evidence strength describes source detail. Undocumented details stay unknown.

Operating levels describe scoped workflows and their human attention boundaries. One system can have several operating models. These levels are not company rankings.

Reported metrics retain their scopes, denominators, dates, and caveats where available. An observation date is not necessarily a measurement window. Conflicting evidence is shown alongside supporting evidence.
